_comment: AIMail agent-side naming contract — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the **agent-internal naming surface** only: skill/toolset registration names and binding/pointer file names. Consumers (Python pysdk/aimail_contract.py, TypeScript tssdk/packages/agent-aimail/src/core/contract.ts) MUST equal these values; tests/contract/check-contract-single-source.py fails the L0 gate on any drift. **Delivery semantics and endpoints are not defined here**: how a host must deliver mail (SSE + long-poll, three mapping edges, C1-C18) lives in docs/aimail-host-sse-contract-v2.md. Trimmed 2026-11-25: the push tri-state was scoped out, the v1 hermes webhook pair left with its adapter, and finally the loopback listener keys (inbound_path / inbound_port) were deleted because SSE-V2 delivers by pulling — a host that answers on a local port is not 'more deliverable'.
notes: Boundary (owner ruling 2026-09-27, breaker = rename commit d701dae 2026-09-03). The legitimate `aimail` surface = product/repo/framework/CLI name + directory name (~/.aimail) + env-var prefix (AIMAIL_*): these are NOT agent-internal contract names and must not be judged violations by this manifest. This manifest constrains only the **agent-internal naming surface**: skill/toolset registration name (agentmail), binding file name (agentmail.json), pointer file name (.agentmail). Verdict = the host builds the skill table from the frontmatter `name:` and looks up by `/{name}` (hermes-agent/agent/skill_commands.py); directory name skills/agentmail + name: aimail => the routing skills=['agentmail'] always misses (gateway log `Skill 'agentmail' not found`) => mail is still delivered but the agent never gets the 6-step reply protocol. The webhook_url field inside the binding file agentmail.json is historical (v1 push) and is always written empty by the v2 adapters; the registered value is the gateway's business, never this contract's. Not covered: Rust (gateway/bridge repos) — the contract source contains no bridge keys (owner ruling 2026-09-28 SDK de-bridging: the bridge = the CLI's environment responsibility, not part of the agent-internal contract surface).
